public_source.author: Jan Kristian Haugland
public_source.parameters: 51 equal-width steps on [0,2], values in [0,1], integral 1
public_source.evidence: The paper reports a 51-step construction and its upper-bound value, rounded upward. The printed coefficients are transcribed in data/human_t082.json.

record.comparison_tolerance: The paper reports 0.3809268534330870 rounded to 16 decimal places; the exact rational transcription scores 0.38092685343308696, a difference of 4e-17 within the 5e-17 rounding interval. Both values refer to the same 51-step witness.
limitations: This is the best located public construction for the fixed 51-step configuration, not a proof of optimality among all 51-step functions.

Later lower reported bounds for the limiting problem use finer discretizations or do not identify a 51-step witness. AlphaEvolve's construction has 95 steps (https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.16175 reports the comparison), TTT-Discover uses 600 steps (https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.16175), and SimpleTES reports a better discretized result without evidence that it uses 51 steps (https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.19341). A later 114688-step construction is listed at https://teorth.github.io/optimizationproblems/constants/1b.html. These results do not match T082-C01.
The source search does not establish an exhaustive survey of every public 51-step construction.
